subject.description: A realistic young woman cosplayer with very long pastel-pink hair and small red devil horns, sitting on a white perforated plastic chair, holding a fluffy white long-haired cat, with one bare foot extended toward the camera so the full sole fills the foreground in a dramatic wide-angle perspective.
subject.mirror_rules: Not a mirror selfie. Direct tripod phone shot. Keep any visible text readable (not mirrored).

face.makeup: doll-like natural glam, long lashes, subtle blush, pale lips, soft highlight; no heavy contour

hair.style: very long straight wig with blunt bangs, a few flyaway strands
hair.effect: silky strands catching warm window light, slight static softness

skin.visible_areas: face, shoulders, arms, thighs, calves, feet
skin.texture: smooth, satin-soft to the touch, with natural pores kept subtle
skin.lighting_effect: warm sunlit patches and gentle shadow gradients from side window light

pose.base: one leg bent on the chair, the other leg extended toward lens
pose.overall: full bare sole facing camera in the foreground; toes and heel fully in frame; hands supporting the cat on the lap; relaxed shoulders

top.effect: slight fabric stretch, clean and minimal

accessories.device: smartphone visible on a tripod/phone clamp in the right foreground
accessories.prop: fluffy white long-haired cat with yellow-green eyes

photography.camera_style: smartphone tripod self-shot, realistic social media portrait
photography.angle: low angle near foot level, wide-angle perspective exaggerating the foreground sole
photography.shot_type: full-body seated portrait with extreme foreground foot
photography.texture: clean digital sharpness with slight phone compression, tiny natural noise, realistic skin detail
photography.lighting: late afternoon warm window sunlight from the right, soft bounce from white walls, gentle shadows
photography.depth_of_field: moderate depth; foreground foot slightly sharper or equal focus with face; background softly softened but recognizable

elements: wood slat wall/partition on the left
white door with a dark handle
pale curtain on the right edge
ceiling hanging lamp with an acorn/pinecone-like shade
small watermark text 'Anastasia Dream' near upper-right
background.lighting: sunbeam streaks on the floor and chair, soft ambient fill

the_vibe.mood: warm afternoon calm with a hint of longing
the_vibe.authenticity: slight camera tilt, imperfect framing, lived-in stillness
the_vibe.intimacy: the viewer is close to the foreground foot, like sitting on the floor nearby
the_vibe.story: She had been setting up a tripod shot when the cat demanded attention; she keeps holding it, eyes drifting upward as sunlight slowly moves across the room.

pastel-pink long straight hair with bangs
white long-haired cat held on lap
smartphone on tripod visible in right foreground
warm window sunlight from right side
